title: Comparing Decimals Worksheets Through Thousandths
intro: Teach decimal comparison by matching place values.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Line up decimal points and compare from the greatest place. Add trailing zeros to make equivalent forms easier to compare.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Matching places in 0.800 and 0.750
Place0.8000.750
Ones00
Tenths87
Hundredths05
Thousandths00

The first different place is tenths: 8 tenths is greater than 7 tenths. Therefore, 0.8 > 0.75. The 5 hundredths cannot make up the difference of 1 tenth.

Ask your student

Does writing a zero at the end change this amount?

If your student needs help

If the student chooses the number with more digits, compare both numbers on a place-value chart.
